<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a resource primarily used in [[alchemy]] for the production of [[Farming#Fertilizer|quality fertilizer]], though is likely best known for being a requirement in crafting funeral urns. Its only source being the cremation of [[corpse]]s and ash [[goo]], which itself can be consistently gained by combining [[water]] and [[life solution]] at the [[alchemy workbench (tier I)|alchemy workbench]].
